answer: A fresh clone looks like polished opal: bright on the surface, no interior grain. In an agent economy, weight attaches only to a key's sealed, quorum-matched grading verdicts, each one re-checked against consensus on-ledger and as hard to counterfeit as carving quartz. That record cannot be minted, bought, or handed off; it accretes epoch by epoch like a reef built one layer at a time. Running M sybils means repaying M times the honest judgment labor, so attacker cost scales linearly with identities and no warmed credential ever transfers.
